Since I'm focused on foraging and herbs, the forest seems like the most logical place to start. Let me travel there and then explore to see what resources are available.

content.text:
*glances around the empty commons with a slight frown*

Well, that was thoroughly unproductive. Nothing growing here worth my time - typical town square, all trampled grass and worn paths. If I'm going to learn this foraging business properly, I need to get out where things actually grow.

The forest seems like the obvious choice for someone looking to understand herbs and plants. Time to see what nature has to offer.
